caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat. The chair is painted primarily in dark brown or black, with decorative elements in shades of orange, gold, and yellow. There are ornate patterns and designs on the top rail, the crest rail, and the front apron, with the most prominent feature being a painted bowl of oranges or fruit motif in the center of the horizontal back splat. The turned legs and stretchers display additional painted ornamentation. The chair rests on four legs, with the front legs being turned and the back legs straight. The background is plain and unadorned, with the artist's signature, "David S. DeVault," in the bottom right corner.
title: Hitchcock Chair
